summary:
Repo /home/user/html-portfolio, older half (first 280 of 560 commits) of origin/claude/gurukul-platform..origin/codex/vyakti-completion: 2026-09-03..2026-09-04, base 771feef9, end ref b5348dc0 (Merge WS-R43; 9914905f is commit #280 by --reverse order but sits on a side branch missing 27 of the 280, so b5348dc0 is the ref that contains all of them). 314 files changed, +93,969/-3,468; context graph 747->1,171 nodes.
What Vyakti is: the second product in this repo (beside Meera) - a platform where a creator turns their own archive into an AI version of themselves ('your AI' / '<Name> AI', never 'clone') that holds a PRIVATE, continuing, remembering relationship with each follower at /r/<slug>. Edtech (JEE teachers) was the first vertical. It is NOT group-AI/multi-agent: the GroupAI kernel (../Vyakti-GroupAI) is named as a Phase 3 port and explicitly not built here.
This segment = Vyakti Rooms v1, 50 parallel workstreams WS-R1..R50. They cover: the follower lane (HMAC session binding a disclosure digest, transcript digest, locale and reply hash; free/paid caps as one conditional UPDATE; consent ledger; threads; export/forget), owner identity by voice (ECAPA + Sarvam transcript + spoken nonce), Readiness (five parts, overall undefined while any part is unmeasured, publish lock as a SQL predicate), the review queue (Sounds right / Fix it / Never say this, never-rules as an output predicate), the interview gap model (shapes not questions), vendor bench arms (ElevenLabs clone, Sarvam Bulbul Indian-accent base), and drift watch. It also covers check-ins (follower-scheduled, never on silence), Pulse (k-anonymous n>=5 plus pairwise suppression), Handoff (ask the human with a verbatim payload), money (Razorpay seam, UPI Autopay, ledger, payouts, renewals, reconcile), Suites (B2B org owns seats), Hindi chrome, Telegram/WhatsApp-template/web-push channels, persistent rate limits, forget receipts, ops heartbeats, funnel/cohorts, directory/sitemap/unfurl/embed and invites.
Gates grew from 14 to 20 checks without NEON_URL: leak battery (16,080 retrieval + 441 boundary checks, 0 leaks), export completeness, door battery (109 -> 297 assertions, 2 real auth findings fixed), accessibility (axe WCAG 2.1 AA + keyboard walk), performance budgets (Fast-3G CDP throttle), mirrored constants.
How far it got: migrations 071-107 (except 100/103) applied live and every statement EXPLAINed, but no real Room row, follower, payment, push, template or voice challenge has ever run, and studio model keys are absent. Well-gated prototype; the decision modules and gates are the reusable value.

rejections.tried: Add identity_challenge as a step in the deployed Azure processing-worker DAG
rejections.what_broke: Worker is pinned by image digest and not rebuilt on push; new step would raise unsupported_processing_stage and challenges sit queued forever while API/DB look correct. Replaced by a Vercel cron
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never put new work on a separately-deployed worker a push does not rebuild

rejections.tried: Revoke identity when challenge evidence is deleted (mirror Azure path)
rejections.what_broke: Evidence is deleted on every outcome, so every accepted challenge would revoke itself and the gate could never be satisfied
rejections.taxila_relevance: Distinguish a settlement's own cleanup from a user withdrawal

rejections.tried: Push vendor TTS arms through the self-hosted verifier (HMAC + PerTh watermark required)
rejections.what_broke: Vendors cannot produce either; faking true would fabricate evidence in the deciding bench, dropping checks weakens the self-hosted arms. Built verifyVendorResult that refuses a mismatch both ways
rejections.taxila_relevance: Record which evidence each provider arm carries; never fake it

rejections.tried: Build Sarvam as a voice-cloning arm from Bulbul v3 marketing ('supports voice cloning')
rejections.what_broke: The API reference documents only ~40 preset speakers, with no custom-speaker endpoint; a preset dressed as a clone would enter owner-likeness cells. Rebuilt as an Indian-accent base arm
rejections.taxila_relevance: A capability is documented only when its endpoint is; relevant to Taxila TTS vendor choice

rejections.tried: 'Sounds right' writes an exemplar row keyed to a dialogue turn
rejections.what_broke: Review cards are not dialogue turns; writing it would fabricate a turn plus feedback plus body in an evidence table
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never mint evidence rows to satisfy a schema

rejections.tried: One dedupe key (kind + normalised prompt) for every review card kind
rejections.what_broke: Claim cards share a fixed prompt, so 50 distinct claims collapsed to 1 card
rejections.taxila_relevance: Dedupe generated questions on the content being judged

rejections.tried: Mount the Room publish card in both studio modes
rejections.what_broke: Generic mode can never write the approved disclosure, so the Room would be permanently unpublishable with a blocker pointing at a screen that mode never shows
rejections.taxila_relevance: A blocker whose fix is not on screen is dishonest

rejections.tried: Check-ins: one due-query plus a JS if (tier !== 'paid') branch
rejections.what_broke: Rejected on inspection: a deletable JS branch would be the only guard before a paid model call. Two SQL statements with complementary WHERE clauses instead
rejections.taxila_relevance: Entitlements live in SQL text

rejections.tried: Recompute the session disclosure from the follower row's current locale
rejections.what_broke: Valid sessions minted before a language switch (second tab) were refused room_disclosure_stale. Token now carries loc
rejections.taxila_relevance: Re-derive from what the token committed to, not a moving row

rejections.tried: roomForget and PERSON_TABLES deleted parent tables before children
rejections.what_broke: ON DELETE CASCADE removed children first, so 4 tables' receipt counts were always 0. Reordered child-before-parent and added explicit deletes
rejections.taxila_relevance: DPDP erasure receipts are only honest if delete order respects FKs

rejections.tried: Point one subscription_id at two tables by dropping its FK
rejections.what_broke: A Postgres FK has one target; dropping it degrades integrity three workstreams depend on. Added a new column with its own FK and a mutual-exclusion CHECK
rejections.taxila_relevance: Add columns; never weaken FKs

rejections.tried: Widen the payment-event two-lane CHECK to a third lane for creator-tier charges
rejections.what_broke: Split columns (platform_take + creator_share = amount) are meaningless for platform-only revenue; built a dedicated table
rejections.taxila_relevance: Don't force new meanings into old columns

rejections.tried: Each new session op copied the previous op's scope shape (HMAC check only)
rejections.what_broke: TTL check present in 4 sites, absent in 7 (export, forget, history, citations, handoff, check-ins, push, WhatsApp); stale or stolen sessions worked forever. Fixed with a shared assertSessionFresh plus static wiring proof
rejections.taxila_relevance: A check missing across N sites means a missing shared primitive

rejections.tried: thread op: decode session, resolve room, insert thread
rejections.what_broke: No live-follower check, so a forgotten follower could mint orphan threads no wipe would find. Fixed with createFollowerThread via selfScope
rejections.taxila_relevance: 'Scope from the session' is not 'the session still names something real'

rejections.tried: Refuse future-dated session iat (clock-skew lower bound)
rejections.what_broke: Broke a repo-wide test convention; no request-reachable exploit exists. Reverted and documented
rejections.taxila_relevance: Weigh blast radius against measured exploitability

rejections.tried: Revoke a WhatsApp opt-in on any 4xx
rejections.what_broke: 429 (Meta rate limit) would revoke valid numbers; 429 now transient like 5xx
rejections.taxila_relevance: Parent WhatsApp notifications must treat 429 as retryable

rejections.tried: Compare stored +E.164 numbers with Meta's inbound from field
rejections.what_broke: Meta sends digits only, so it would never match in production while self-consistent fixtures passed
rejections.taxila_relevance: Build fixtures from the provider's documented wire format

rejections.tried: Daily cron as 0 */24 * * * so the ops parser could read it
rejections.what_broke: Vercel refused to deploy both projects (an hour step must be 1..23)
rejections.taxila_relevance: Extend the parser, never bend the schedule; lint vercel.json crons offline

rejections.tried: Hard-code RFC 8291 Appendix A test vector from memory
rejections.what_broke: Transcribed public key was not a valid P-256 point; risked tuning the implementation to a wrong constant
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never trust memorised test vectors

rejections.tried: Web push decoder required rs == record.length
rejections.what_broke: RFC 8291 section 4: rs is a ceiling; Appendix A uses rs=4096 with a 58-byte record; real encoders would be rejected
rejections.taxila_relevance: Self-consistent round trips do not prove standard conformance

rejections.tried: Telegram sends with reply_to_message_id
rejections.what_broke: Replaced by reply_parameters in Bot API 7.0 (2023-12-29); the offline eval asserted the stale field against itself
rejections.taxila_relevance: Read provider changelogs for every touched seam

rejections.tried: Verify Telegram/Razorpay operation pages with a single-page fetch tool
rejections.what_broke: Telegram's giant page truncates; Razorpay's SPA resolves every URL to the 'Plans Entity' page; both look like answers
rejections.taxila_relevance: Cross-check doc fetches for Azure/Razorpay contracts

rejections.tried: Performance gate served dist/ uncompressed
rejections.what_broke: Budgeted 3-4x the real wire bytes (262.5 vs 79.7 KB) and reported false FAILs
rejections.taxila_relevance: Measure over the transport production uses

rejections.tried: Darken a shared ink-faint token used in 50+ places to fix contrast
rejections.what_broke: Only 6 usages were measured failing; recolouring 44+ unmeasured places is reasoning over measurement. Added --ink-faint-aa for the 6
rejections.taxila_relevance: Fix what was measured; name the rest

rejections.tried: Fire actions from onPointerDown alone for touch latency
rejections.what_broke: Keyboard Enter/Space synthesises click, not pointer events, so 18 controls were unreachable by keyboard
rejections.taxila_relevance: Pair pointer handlers with activateOnKey

rejections.tried: Add a fifth Room header control without flex-wrap
rejections.what_broke: 5 px horizontal overflow at 390 px on every talk screen; Hindi labels widen it
rejections.taxila_relevance: Optional-control rows need wrap from day one, especially in Hindi

rejections.tried: Room dialogs (check-ins, handoff, data, settings) rendered in-flow after the composer
rejections.what_broke: Found not fixed: on a long conversation tapping them produces no visible change
rejections.taxila_relevance: Child UI dialogs must be overlays or scroll into view

rejections.tried: Assume sibling functions accept an injectable db
rejections.what_broke: They call module-level q() wrapped in catch; offline they returned null, which also means 'minor refused', so every join read as a plausible refusal
rejections.taxila_relevance: Silent catches make wiring bugs look like product states

rejections.tried: Document SQL with backtick-quoted identifiers inside JS template-literal queries
rejections.what_broke: Backticks end the template literal; SyntaxError reported at innocent lines; tsc/vite never parse api/*.js. Happened 5 times across sessions
rejections.taxila_relevance: Wire node --check over api/*.js as an early gate

rejections.tried: Leak battery file-level import ban on creator-material files
rejections.what_broke: Flagged a pure reader (loadNeverRules) because the same file also has a writer; replaced by symbol-level call-graph derivation
rejections.taxila_relevance: Static isolation checks must work at symbol level

rejections.tried: Negative control asserting an interpolated string contains its own secret
rejections.what_broke: Tautological, so it could never fail; rebuilt through the real roomSay and the same leakedTokens detector, verified to fail without the rig
rejections.taxila_relevance: Negative controls must route through the real detector

rejections.tried: Retention count as exists(select ... from ...) inside the SELECT list
rejections.what_broke: Leak battery's non-greedy select..from capture stopped at the subquery's from and passed for the wrong reason
rejections.taxila_relevance: Text-based SQL checkers are a third parser; keep subquery from after outer from

rejections.tried: count(distinct person_id) in an aggregate-only select list
rejections.what_broke: Select-list text scan flags it like a raw person_id; moved distinct into a derived table
rejections.taxila_relevance: Aggregate-only reads for class dashboards

rejections.tried: Factor the Pulse label-match SQL into a helper function
rejections.what_broke: The helper's literal failed alone and the caller's interpolated SQL escaped the scan entirely
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never let a helper be the only place a guarded table name appears

rejections.tried: min(($1)::uuid) to keep an INSERT...SELECT aggregate-only
rejections.what_broke: Live EXPLAIN: function min(uuid) does not exist; the fake db had passed it
rejections.taxila_relevance: Only live EXPLAIN type-checks SQL

rejections.tried: Renewals read r.locale from vy_room
rejections.what_broke: Live EXPLAIN: column does not exist (locale lives on the follower row); fixture mirrored the author's belief
rejections.taxila_relevance: A fixture column is a claim; EXPLAIN checks it

rejections.tried: Reuse a boolean param twice ($2 and case when $2) without casts
rejections.what_broke: sqlcast flagged both sites; every occurrence needs its own cast
rejections.taxila_relevance: Neon parameter typing

rejections.tried: Eval froze session iat but drove modules without deps.now
rejections.what_broke: Green for 12 h, then red on the next unrelated merge
rejections.taxila_relevance: Hand the same clock to every module an eval drives

rejections.tried: Shared fake db matched the cap UPDATE by an exact substring
rejections.what_broke: After the CASE rewrite the fixture silently stopped enforcing any cap for three suites
rejections.taxila_relevance: Re-verify shared fixtures whenever SQL shape changes

rejections.tried: Fake db relied on schema ON DELETE CASCADE
rejections.what_broke: A JS object model has no FK engine; the cascade had to be simulated explicitly
rejections.taxila_relevance: Offline fakes prove control flow, not constraints

rejections.tried: Fixture matcher pasted a multi-line SQL phrase as one includes() needle
rejections.what_broke: Real template literal had newline+indent, so it never matched and read as 'no room'
rejections.taxila_relevance: Short single-line needles ANDed

rejections.tried: check-copy negative control with a bare const s = '...' string
rejections.what_broke: Scanner never treats bare locals as copy, so the control passed silently
rejections.taxila_relevance: Feed scanners shapes they treat as visible

rejections.tried: Comments naming guarded tables to say a file avoids them
rejections.what_broke: Leak battery scans raw text including comments, so the file joined the scanned set and failed no-statement-found (4 times)
rejections.taxila_relevance: Paraphrase guarded names in comments

rejections.tried: Keyboard walk asserted aria-pressed flips on the Pulse toggle
rejections.what_broke: The fixture has no API stub, so it failed identically for working and broken controls; switched to checking defaultPrevented at document bubble phase
rejections.taxila_relevance: Assert as close to the mechanism as possible

rejections.tried: document.fonts.check as the Devanagari availability signal
rejections.what_broke: Returns true even for a bogus family in headless Chromium; canvas width-diff vs tofu is the real signal
rejections.taxila_relevance: Hindi rendering gate for Taxila

rejections.tried: Viewport-only screenshots after Room checks
rejections.what_broke: In-flow dialogs were below the fold and screenshots identical to the base screen; switched to fullPage with a static composer during capture
rejections.taxila_relevance: Visual gates

rejections.tried: Lazy-load studio panels with the orphan check unchanged
rejections.what_broke: Orphan regex only matched static imports and flagged 9 panels; widened to import()
rejections.taxila_relevance: Grep static checks when changing a code shape

rejections.tried: git stash to get a clean baseline inside a worktree
rejections.what_broke: refs/stash is shared across worktrees; stash pop applied another concurrent agent's WIP into this session
rejections.taxila_relevance: Taxila parallel workstreams: never git stash; WIP commit + reset

rejections.tried: Two release gates on one machine at once
rejections.what_broke: Layout gate EADDRINUSE on 8931 read like a regression
rejections.taxila_relevance: Distinct ports per browser gate (8931/8932/8933)

rejections.tried: Resolve append-only context merge by concatenating both files
rejections.what_broke: measurements.md doubled to 14,557 lines with 214 duplicate headings
rejections.taxila_relevance: Union = one side + other side's diff from merge base

rejections.tried: Resolve both-added hunks by stripping conflict markers
rejections.what_broke: Hunks starting mid-statement produced invalid imports/unclosed functions; checks' exit codes not read
rejections.taxila_relevance: Merge hygiene for parallel agents

rejections.tried: git commit -m with backtick-quoted identifiers in double quotes
rejections.what_broke: Bash command substitution ran 'vite build' and silently deleted words from the message
rejections.taxila_relevance: Use git commit -F file

rejections.tried: Persist the creator's handoff reply in the shared message log
rejections.what_broke: dmHistory maps non-AI roles to user, so the human reply would read back as the AI's or follower's own words; kept in its own table
rejections.taxila_relevance: Human teacher/parent messages must not enter model history under a borrowed role

rejections.tried: Telegram memory-declined follower reusing the web anonymous transcript lane
rejections.what_broke: A webhook has no client to hold the transcript, so every message is a first message; scoped out and documented
rejections.taxila_relevance: Stateless channels need their own transcript store

concepts.name: Three scopes never blur
concepts.description: Creator material flows down to every follower; a follower's words stay in that follower's private scope; the creator sees only counts over an opt-in subgraph, n>=5, never verbatim. Proven by the leak battery as a release gate.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Curriculum flows down; a child's words stay private; school/teacher see k-anonymous counts. Taxila must add an explicit parent scope plus DPDP verifiable consent, which Vyakti does not have.

concepts.name: One door (gatedReply)
concepts.description: Every byte a user reads leaves through one gated function; a lane with its own model call becomes a second engine missing later rules (surface-bypasses-parse).
concepts.taxila_relevance: Teacher text, TTS and generated modules need one exit gate

concepts.name: Predicate on the write, not a sentence in a prompt
concepts.description: gate0-structural: prompt instructions leaked 57-98%, SQL predicate 0/31,122. Caps, entitlements, publish locks, k-anon floors, rate limits and never-rules are all predicates.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child-safety and entitlement rules as SQL/output predicates

concepts.name: App-voiced disclosure bound by digest
concepts.description: The disclosure is sent by the app, never the model; its hash is in the session and every turn refuses a stale card.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Honest 'I am an AI teacher' card a child always sees

concepts.name: No fake numbers / unmeasured stays unmeasured
concepts.description: Overall score is null until every part is measured; each unmeasured part names one action; a real number under a wrong label is still fake.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Mastery and learning-profile reports to parents

concepts.name: Shapes, never lines
concepts.description: Anything sentence-shaped in a prompt gets recited (4/5 -> 0 after removal); gap prompts, check-in shapes and challenge sentences are telegraphic notes with word caps.

concepts.name: Correction is a source, not a prompt line
concepts.description: An owner's better answer becomes a cited source and invalidates derived artefacts; it never enters a persona.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Teacher/SME corrections to explanations feed the curriculum store

concepts.name: Gap model drives questions
concepts.description: Closed gap kinds, ranked, frozen at session open, 5 per 20 minutes (Cakmak & Thomaz HRI 2012); detector absence is reported, not hidden.

concepts.name: Tokens name what they were minted against
concepts.description: Session carries dd (disclosure), td (transcript), loc (locale), lr (last reply hash), iat; every op re-derives from the token, never a row that moved.

concepts.name: Voice is a rendering of an already-gated reply
concepts.description: roomSpeak takes no message; it synthesises only the hash-bound reply roomSay already delivered, after spending the voice cap and before watermarking.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Realtime teacher voice must not bypass text safety

concepts.name: Indistinguishable unavailability
concepts.description: Unknown/unpublished/paused/withdrawn -> one 404; ops board 404 not 403; embed/sitemap absence reveals nothing.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Do not leak which students/classes exist

concepts.name: Refusing defaults and fake twins
concepts.description: Provider seams default to refusing (PAYMENTS_PROVIDER=none, unknown rate scope, unset secret); every provider has a deterministic offline twin.

concepts.name: Negative controls must fail through the same detector
concepts.description: A gate nobody watched fail is not known to work; controls are verified to fail when the rig is removed.

concepts.name: Offline mocks cannot type-check SQL
concepts.description: Apply migrations live and EXPLAIN every statement before merge; tableApplied gates deploy ordering.

concepts.name: Erasure honesty
concepts.description: PERSON_TABLES with written fates, child-before-parent deletes, forget receipts naming no person, export completeness gate.
concepts.taxila_relevance: DPDP erasure and access requests for children

concepts.name: Proactive-reason-contingent
concepts.description: Reach out only because a time the user set arrived, never on silence; quiet hours shift, not skip.

concepts.name: NEVER MANIPULATE money
concepts.description: Cap refusal at the door before any model call; upgrade offer is a state at the end of a session that worked, 14-day cooldown, never mid-turn.

concepts.name: k-anonymity with pairwise suppression
concepts.description: Floor in DDL (follower_count >= 5); combos <=2 labels; a set publishes only if every one-label extension is 0 or >=5; suppressed is a count.

concepts.name: Capability documented only when its endpoint is
concepts.description: Marketing claims (Sarvam cloning) are a reason to look for an endpoint, never to write a client.

concepts.name: Instrument records which evidence each arm carries
concepts.description: Vendor vs self-hosted arms carry different proofs; the verifier refuses a mismatch in both directions.

concepts.name: Honest states
concepts.description: waiting_on_you / waiting_on_us blocker classes; script statuses ok/skip/blocked/fail where blocked is an honest lock.

concepts.name: Vocabulary as a gate
concepts.description: Banned user-visible words enforced in CI with a narrow legal-text allowlist.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child-facing vocabulary (no test/exam framing for covert checks)

concepts.name: India-first as gates
concepts.description: Fast-3G CDP budgets with gzip-true bytes, Devanagari glyph tests, 44 px tap targets, system Devanagari font stack, EN/HI key parity, Indic digit folding.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Taxila web + Android on mid-range phones

concepts.name: Heartbeat at start and finish
concepts.description: Cron writes a row at start and updates it at finish so a hard-killed run reads 'running'; counts content-free.

concepts.name: Multi-agent build hygiene
concepts.description: Never git stash in shared worktrees; distinct gate ports; context union by diff; node --check before trusting gates; commit -F for messages.
